body.message:
We did not break or damage anything, and we left the apartment clean.

The balcony is dusty and dirty, and we even had to clean it ourselves. Every time we went onto the balcony and then came back inside, the dirt from the balcony left black marks on the rug and on the floor throughout the apartment. That is not our responsibility.

Please return my security deposit. I have done nothing wrong, and the kitchen and the entire apartment were left clean. This feels like an excuse to keep our deposit.

Before leaving, I even asked a Peninsula security guard to inspect the apartment, and I have proof that everything was left clean. Please return my deposit.
